definitions.gloss: under repair; being repaired; closed for repairs
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is currently in the process of being repaired or maintained. Commonly seen on signs and notices.

examples.japanese: エレベーターは{修理中|しゅうりちゅう}です。
{修理中|しゅうりちゅう}のため、{使用|しよう}できません。
examples.english: It cannot be used because it is under repair.

examples.japanese: パソコンが{修理中|しゅうりちゅう}なので、{今週|こんしゅう}はスマートフォンで{仕事|しごと}をしている。
examples.english: Since my computer is being repaired, I'm working on my smartphone this week.

notes:
A compound of {修理|しゅうり} (repair) and {中|ちゅう} (in the middle of, during). The suffix {中|ちゅう} is highly productive and attaches to many nouns to indicate an ongoing state.

USAGE:
Very commonly seen on signs posted on equipment, facilities, roads, and buildings. Often appears on its own as a sign: {修理中|しゅうりちゅう}. Can be used as a no-adjective with の: {修理中|しゅうりちゅう}の{車|くるま} (a car under repair).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修理中|しゅうりちゅう}のため — due to being under repair
- {現在|げんざい}{修理中|しゅうりちゅう} — currently under repair
- {修理中|しゅうりちゅう}の{機器|きき} — equipment under repair

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- {工事中|こうじちゅう} — under construction
- {点検中|てんけんちゅう} — under inspection
- {調整中|ちょうせいちゅう} — being adjusted; under adjustment
- {準備中|じゅんびちゅう} — in preparation; not yet open
